name: Beyond the Chrysalis
passiveDesc: Each time the equipping character uses their Elemental Skill or Elemental Burst, they gain one of the following three effects in sequence: Winds of Devotion: Increases the equipping character's CRIT DMG by 56/72/88/104/120% for 10s; Winds of Defiance: Increases Stellar Swirl reaction DMG dealt by the equipping character by 36/45/54/63/72% for 10s; and Winds of Plenty: Regenerates 5/5.5/6/6.5/7 Elemental Energy for the equipping character. Up to 5/5.5/6/6.5/7 Elemental Energy can be regenerated in this way every 4s. The aforementioned effects are removed and the sequence is reset when the equipping character leaves the field.
description: A longsword brimming with light and color, and as weightless as a butterfly when brandished. It was once used by a certain individual to break bonds.

modifiers.label: Winds of Devotion — CRIT DMG while the first sequence buff is active
Winds of Defiance — Stellar Swirl DMG while the second sequence buff is active
